subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should the remaining durable-approval integration be rebuilt on top of the newer current-main mobile approval landing rather than resolving this branch's overlapping native stack in place?
rationale: The exact branch is conflicting across security- and session-sensitive approval paths, and only an approval-stack owner can confirm which side represents the intended canonical native behavior after the newer main landing.

options.title: Rebuild on current main
options.body: Recreate only the remaining gateway, session, and tool-gate delta atop current main, then rerun compatibility, security, and real-device proof.

options.title: Resolve this branch manually
options.body: Retain this branch and have an approval-stack owner resolve all six conflicts with explicit before-and-after contract evidence.

options.title: Split or pause integration
options.body: Land independently reviewable remaining pieces separately or defer the consolidation if the overlapping native delta is no longer worth carrying.

recommendation.title: Rebuild on current main
recommendation.body: Recreate only the remaining gateway, session, and tool-gate delta atop current main, then rerun compatibility, security, and real-device proof.
